text:
ops-lead: RCA published for the cache-eviction incident that caused degraded serving for ~1h. Full doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/CEvictionRCA :memo: Please read the summary below and react with :thumbsup: when you've read and acknowledged.

ops-lead: TL;DR: eviction policy misfire due to simultaneous rolling restarts + tuning change; KV-cache reopened with full cold-state and heavy prefix churn. No customer data lost, but P95 latency spiked and some requests timed out.

ops-lead: Key action items (owners + due dates):
1) revert/guard the new eviction tuning behind a feature flag — owner: chris — due: 2026-04-02
2) add canary rollout for cache param changes (automated gating) — owner: maya — due: 2026-04-09
3) implement prefix-hit telemetry to detect cold-cache surges — owner: sam — due: 2026-04-05
4) run DR drill to validate restart sequences under load — owner: lucy — due: 2026-04-15

ops-lead: Checkpoints: weekly sync for 4 weeks, first follow-up on 2026-04-06 15:00 UTC (calendar invite sent). Please add any blockers to the RCA doc under "Blockers & Notes."

incident-bot: Incident summary: SEV2 at 1909871450, mitigated at 1909875000. Automations: rolling-restart monitor fired. Logs/artifacts linked in doc.

chris: ack — I'm rolling the revert now and will open the PR with the feature-flag guard. PR link will be in the RCA.

maya: I'll own the canary gating work. planning to draft the automation spec tomorrow and pair with eng-platform.

sam: adding telemetry ticket to backlog: REDWOOD-8672. I'll attach dashboards and example alert rules.

lucy: volunteering to run the DR drill with infra — will coordinate with oncall and schedule pre-check tomorrow.

chris: quick Q — do we want the default eviction threshold rolled back cluster-wide or staged per region? ops-lead: ops-lead: stage per region, start with us-east-1 canary.

maya: note for docs: update the runbook with the new revert steps and add a 'how to validate cache warmup' checklist.

ops-lead: thanks all. Please mark your action items in the RCA doc and add estimates. We'll use the weekly checkpoint to close items; if anything slips, flag it on the doc and ping me.

sam: :thumbsup:

chris: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1427 — reverting tuning + feature flag, added test.

lucy: scheduled DR drill invite created: 2026-04-08 10:00 UTC.

ops-lead: final note: retrospective items captured in the doc under "longer-term improvements" — include kernel scheduling and smarter KV-restore. Expect follow-up RFC from eng-runtime in 2 weeks.

maya: ack, will review RFC when posted.

ops-lead: if you haven't reacted, please do so and confirm ownership by EOD. Thanks everyone. :wave:
